title: SwapVM Instruction Trace
description: Schema for a SwapVM strategy execution trace produced by AquaLab. Version 1.0.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version — must be '1.0' for this draft.

blockNumber.description: Block in which the swap executed (or simulated).

txHash.description: Transaction hash. Use a descriptive placeholder (e.g. 0x000...0001) for simulated traces.

tokenA.description: First token (conventionally the token sold by the maker, e.g. WETH).

tokenB.description: Second token (conventionally the token bought by the maker, e.g. USDC).

swapAmountIn.description: Gross input amount (smallest unit, base-10 string to preserve uint256).

swapAmountOut.description: Net output amount after all fees and decay adjustments.

swapDirection.description: Whether the taker sells tokenA and buys tokenB, or vice-versa.

totalFeesBps.description: Effective total fee in basis points (out of 10000, i.e. 30 = 0.30%) applied across all steps.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the trace (shown in UI dropdown).

steps.description: Ordered list of SwapVM instruction executions, from first to last.

bigint.description: Non-negative integer stored as base-10 string (safe for uint256).

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index of this step in the pipeline.

opcode.description: SwapVM opcode name exactly as it appears in the AquaOpcodes instruction set.

description.description: Human-readable one-liner explaining what this step does in context.

params.description: Decoded opcode parameters — shape varies by opcode (see below).

gasUsed.description: Gas consumed by this instruction (optional, for display).

revertReason.description: Non-null if this step reverted (should only happen in error traces).

salt.description: 64-bit salt value used to perturb the order hash (ensures unique strategy identifiers).

decayPeriodSeconds.description: Full decay period in seconds (the window over which the offset linearly decays to 0).

elapsedSeconds.description: Seconds elapsed since last interaction (drives decay magnitude).

currentOffsetIn.description: Current stored offset for tokenIn (decayed from prior trades). Added to balanceIn as virtual reserve boost.

currentOffsetOut.description: Current stored offset for tokenOut (decayed from prior trades). Subtracted from balanceOut as virtual reserve penalty.

feeBps.description: Fee rate in SwapVM units (1e9 = 100%). E.g. 3_000_000 = 0.30%.

humanFeeBps.description: Fee rate in traditional basis points (out of 10000). E.g. 30 = 0.30%.

grossAmountIn.description: Full taker-defined amountIn before fee deduction.

feeAmount.description: Fee deducted from amountIn (ceiling division): ceil(grossAmountIn * feeBps / 1e9).

netAmountIn.description: Net input the AMM sees: grossAmountIn - feeAmount.

virtualBalanceIn.description: Effective balanceIn seen by the AMM (real + decay offset adjustment).

virtualBalanceOut.description: Effective balanceOut seen by the AMM (real - decay offset adjustment).

virtualBalanceIn.description: Virtual balanceIn = real balanceIn + L-based extension.

virtualBalanceOut.description: Virtual balanceOut = real balanceOut + L-based extension.

token.description: Reference to tokenA or tokenB defined in metadata.

balanceSnapshot.description: Token balances at a specific point in execution.

curveState.description: AMM curve state after this step completes.

realReserves.description: Real (physical) token reserves in the pool.

virtualReserves.description: Virtual reserves including MEV-protection offset from _decayXD and/or concentrated-liquidity extension from _xycConcentrateGrowLiquidity2D.

spotPriceAInB.description: Spot price: how many units of tokenB per 1 unit of tokenA (human-readable, e.g. 3000 for $3000/ETH).

feeBps.description: Fee in traditional basis points (out of 10000) applied at this step.

concentratedRange.description: Non-null when active concentrated range exists.

priceLower.description: Lower price bound of the concentrated range (tokenB per tokenA).

priceUpper.description: Upper price bound of the concentrated range (tokenB per tokenA).

isInRange.description: Whether the current spot price is within [priceLower, priceUpper].

swapPointX.description: Normalised X-coordinate of the swap point on the price curve (0–1), for animation.
